boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten no-cost ways for enrolled UE students to move, make plans, or see art on and near campus.

cards.title: Join a Pilates class
cards.subtitle: UE Fitness Center · University of Evansville
cards.notes: Bring a friend to the Monday morning Pilates class during fall or spring semester; it is listed among UE’s free Fitness Center classes.
cards.short_summary: A scheduled Pilates session for the campus community.
cards.evidence_claim: UE states that Fitness Center classes are offered free of charge to enrolled students, faculty, and staff during fall and spring; Pilates appears on the Spring 2026 schedule.
cards.source_title: Fitness Center Classes | University of Evansville
cards.access_notes: For enrolled students, faculty, and staff during fall and spring semesters; check the current schedule before going.

cards.title: Play lunchtime pickleball
cards.subtitle: UE Fitness Center · University of Evansville
cards.notes: Meet up at the Fitness Center for the scheduled noon pickleball slot, then confirm the semester schedule with campus recreation.
cards.short_summary: A midday racquet-sport option on the UE schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: UE lists Pickleball on its Spring 2026 Fitness Center class schedule and states these classes are free for enrolled students, faculty, and staff.
cards.source_title: Fitness Center Classes | University of Evansville
cards.access_notes: For enrolled students, faculty, and staff during fall and spring semesters; check the current schedule before going.

cards.title: Take a WERQ class
cards.subtitle: UE Fitness Center · University of Evansville
cards.notes: Use the Monday evening WERQ session as an easy group plan; arrive ready to participate and verify the current class calendar first.
cards.short_summary: A scheduled dance-fitness class at the Fitness Center.
cards.evidence_claim: UE lists WERQ on its Spring 2026 Fitness Center class schedule and states these classes are free for enrolled students, faculty, and staff.
cards.source_title: Fitness Center Classes | University of Evansville
cards.access_notes: For enrolled students, faculty, and staff during fall and spring semesters; check the current schedule before going.

cards.title: Go to open swim
cards.subtitle: UE Fitness Center · University of Evansville
cards.notes: Plan a low-key swim during the listed evening or weekend open-swim times, and check availability because lifeguard coverage can affect sessions.
cards.short_summary: Scheduled pool time at the campus Fitness Center.
cards.evidence_claim: UE’s current Fitness Center classes page lists weekday evening and weekend Open Swim, and states Fitness Center classes are free for enrolled students, faculty, and staff.
cards.source_title: Fitness Center Classes | University of Evansville
cards.access_notes: For enrolled students, faculty, and staff; Open Swim is pending lifeguard availability according to UE.

cards.title: Try Total Body Fitness
cards.subtitle: UE Fitness Center · University of Evansville
cards.notes: Pick the Tuesday or Thursday Total Body Fitness time for a planned workout with classmates, then verify the active semester schedule.
cards.short_summary: A group fitness option scheduled twice weekly.
cards.evidence_claim: UE lists Total Body Fitness on its Spring 2026 Fitness Center class schedule and states these classes are free for enrolled students, faculty, and staff.
cards.source_title: Fitness Center Classes | University of Evansville
cards.access_notes: For enrolled students, faculty, and staff during fall and spring semesters; check the current schedule before going.

cards.title: Ride in the cycling class
cards.subtitle: UE Fitness Center · University of Evansville
cards.notes: Coordinate for the Tuesday cycling class and use the scheduled hour for a shared campus workout without a separate class charge.
cards.short_summary: A campus cycling workout on the Fitness Center schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: UE lists a Cycling Class on its Spring 2026 Fitness Center class schedule and states these classes are free for enrolled students, faculty, and staff.
cards.source_title: Fitness Center Classes | University of Evansville
cards.access_notes: For enrolled students, faculty, and staff during fall and spring semesters; check the current schedule before going.

cards.title: Unwind with yoga
cards.subtitle: UE Fitness Center · University of Evansville
cards.notes: Make a Wednesday evening yoga class your shared reset; consult the Fitness Center’s current schedule before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A scheduled yoga class for eligible campus users.
cards.evidence_claim: UE lists Yoga on its Spring 2026 Fitness Center class schedule and states these classes are free for enrolled students, faculty, and staff.
cards.source_title: Fitness Center Classes | University of Evansville

cards.title: Move at Hype Hop Dance Fitness
cards.subtitle: UE Fitness Center · University of Evansville
cards.notes: Gather a small group for Thursday’s Hype Hop Dance Fitness class and confirm that the semester schedule has not changed.
cards.short_summary: A weekly dance-fitness session in the Fitness Center.
cards.evidence_claim: UE lists Hype Hop Dance Fitness on its Spring 2026 Fitness Center class schedule and states these classes are free for enrolled students, faculty, and staff.
cards.source_title: Fitness Center Classes | University of Evansville

cards.title: See changing art exhibitions
cards.subtitle: 1935 Lincoln Avenue · University of Evansville
cards.notes: Drop in during listed gallery hours to view changing work by local and regional artists, alumni, and students; call ahead for access questions.
cards.short_summary: UE’s dedicated gallery for rotating exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: UE identifies the Melvin Peterson Gallery as an exhibit space with changing artwork; the university states all exhibits are free, open to the public, and accessible.
cards.access_notes: UE’s gallery page lists hours when the University is in session and advises calling the Art Department with exhibit or access questions.

cards.title: Browse the Krannert Gallery
cards.subtitle: Krannert Hall of Art and Music · University of Evansville
cards.notes: Walk through the Krannert Hall lobby to view changing student and professional-artist exhibitions, then confirm access if campus is not in session.
cards.short_summary: A lobby gallery with rotating student and professional work.
cards.evidence_claim: UE describes Krannert Gallery as featuring changing exhibits by students and professional artists; the university states all exhibits are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: UE lists Krannert Gallery hours when the University is in session and directs visitors to contact the Art Department with access questions.
